faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions about EnjoySA

booking.question: How do I book a tour?
booking.answer: Browse our products, select your preferred date and number of participants, then click "Book Now". Complete the payment to confirm your booking. You will receive a confirmation email with your e-ticket.

booking.question: How far in advance should I book?
booking.answer: We recommend booking at least 24-48 hours in advance. During peak seasons (school holidays, public holidays), booking 1 week ahead is advised. Popular products may require earlier booking.

booking.question: Can I book for someone else?
booking.answer: Yes. You can book for family and friends. Just enter the actual participant information when making the booking.

payment.question: What payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: We accept multiple payment methods including WeChat Pay, Alipay, UnionPay, Visa/Mastercard credit cards. All payments are processed through secure encrypted channels.

payment.question: How do I request a refund?
payment.answer: To request a refund, go to "My Orders", find the relevant order, and click "Request Refund". We will review your request within 1-3 business days. Eligible refunds will be processed within 5-10 business days.

payment.question: What is the refund policy?
payment.answer: Full refund for cancellations 7+ days before departure; 50% refund for 3-7 days; no refund within 72 hours. Specific policies may vary by product - please check the product details.

tour.question: Is hotel pickup included?
tour.answer: Most products include pickup from Adelaide CBD hotels. Please check product details for specific pickup arrangements. Some products may require self-transport to the meeting point.

tour.question: Will tours be cancelled due to weather?
tour.answer: If severe weather makes the activity unsafe, we will notify you in advance and arrange a reschedule or full refund. Please ensure your contact details are accurate.

tour.question: What should I bring?
tour.answer: Depending on the activity, we recommend: comfortable walking shoes, sunscreen, hat, camera, drinking water. Check the product details page for specific recommendations.

other.question: How can I contact customer service?
other.answer: You can reach us by: Phone +61 8 XXXX XXXX (business hours), Email support@enjoysa.com.au, or use the live chat feature on our website. We will respond as soon as possible.

other.question: How do I submit a review?
other.answer: After completing your tour, you can leave a review in "My Orders". Your honest feedback helps other users make decisions and helps us improve our services.

other.question: How can I become a partner?
other.answer: If you are a South Australian tourism provider, we welcome partnerships. Please email partner@enjoysa.com.au with your company introduction and product information.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content:
Welcome to EnjoySA. By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Modified terms will be effective immediately upon posting on the website. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

description.title: 2. Service Description
description.content:
EnjoySA is a travel booking platform providing tourism product booking services in the South Australia region, including but not limited to: day tours, multi-day tours, tickets, and transfer services.

We act as an intermediary platform connecting users with tourism service providers. Actual travel services are provided by third-party service providers; we do not directly participate in service execution.

account.title: 3. User Accounts
account.content:
Using certain services may require account registration. You agree to:
• Provide accurate and complete registration information
• Protect your account security and not share login credentials
• Be responsible for all activities under your account
• Notify us immediately upon discovering unauthorized use

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts upon detecting violations.

booking.title: 4. Booking and Payment
booking.content:
4.1 Booking Confirmation
After submitting a booking and completing payment, you will receive a confirmation email. Only receipt of a confirmation email indicates a successful booking.

4.2 Prices and Fees
All prices are displayed in Australian Dollars (AUD). Prices may change; the price at the time of booking applies.

4.3 Payment Security
We use secure third-party payment processing services. We do not store your complete payment information.

cancellation.title: 5. Cancellation and Refunds
cancellation.content:
5.1 User Cancellation
Cancellation policies vary by product. Please refer to the specific product's cancellation policy. General rules:
• 7+ days before departure: Full refund
• 3-7 days before departure: 50% refund
• Within 72 hours of departure: No refund

5.2 Provider Cancellation
If a provider cancels, you may choose to reschedule or request a full refund.

5.3 Force Majeure
For cancellations due to weather, natural disasters, or other force majeure events, we will assist with rescheduling or refunds.

conduct.title: 6. User Conduct
conduct.content:
When using our services, you agree to:
• Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
• Respect other users and service providers
• Not post false, misleading, or harmful information
• Not engage in any behavior that may harm platform operations
• Not abuse promotions, discounts, or reward mechanisms

Violation of these guidelines may result in account suspension or termination.

ip.title: 7. Intellectual Property
ip.content:
All content on the website, including but not limited to text, images, icons, and interface designs, is protected by intellectual property laws.

Without our written permission, you may not copy, modify, distribute, or otherwise use this content. For user-submitted reviews and content, you grant us a non-exclusive license to use.

disclaimer.title: 8. Disclaimer
disclaimer.content:
8.1 Service Provided 'As Is'
We strive to ensure service availability and accuracy but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service.

8.2 Third-Party Services
We are not directly responsible for the quality of third-party service providers' services. We will assist in mediating disputes.

8.3 Limitation of Liability
To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the booking fees you paid.

dispute.title: 9. Dispute Resolution
dispute.content:
In case of disputes, parties should first attempt amicable resolution. If unsuccessful, disputes should be submitted to a court of competent jurisdiction in South Australia, Australia.

These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of South Australia, Australia.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content:
EnjoySA understands the importance of personal privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information.

By using our services, you agree to the data processing practices described in this Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read this policy carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.content:
We may collect the following types of personal information:

1.1 Information You Provide
• Registration information: name, email, phone number
• Booking information: travel dates, number of participants, special requirements
• Payment information: payment method, transaction records (we do not store complete card details)
• Communications: conversations with customer service, reviews and feedback

1.2 Automatically Collected Information
• Device information: device type, operating system, browser type
• Log information: access time, page views, IP address
• Information collected through cookies and similar technologies

usage.title: 2. How We Use Information
usage.content:
We use your information to:

• Process your bookings and provide services
• Send booking confirmations, trip reminders, and important notifications
• Improve our products and services
• Provide customer support
• Send marketing communications (opt-out available)
• Prevent fraud and ensure security
• Comply with legal obligations

sharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
sharing.content:
We may share your information in the following circumstances:

3.1 Service Providers
To complete your booking, we share necessary information with tourism service providers (pickup times, group size, etc.).

3.2 Payment Processors
Processing payments requires sharing relevant information with third-party payment service providers.

3.3 Legal Requirements
We may disclose your information when required by law or upon lawful government requests.

3.4 Business Transfers
In the event of a merger or acquisition, your information may be transferred as a business asset.

We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content:
We use cookies and similar technologies to:

• Remember your preferences and settings
• Analyze website traffic and usage
• Provide personalized content and advertising
• Improve user experience

You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect certain features.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content:
We implement various security measures to protect your information:

• SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission
• Encrypted storage of sensitive data
• Regular security audits and updates
• Employee training and access controls
• Secure data center hosting

While we strive to protect your information, internet transmission cannot be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.content:
We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary:

• Account information: during account existence and a reasonable period after closure
• Transaction records: as required by financial and legal requirements
• Log data: typically no longer than 12 months

You may request deletion of your personal information at any time, though some information may need to be retained for legal reasons.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.content:
Under applicable privacy laws, you may have the following rights:

• Access: request access to your personal information we hold
• Rectification: request correction of inaccurate information
• Deletion: request deletion of your personal information
• Restriction: request restriction of processing
• Data Portability: request your data in a machine-readable format
• Objection: object to certain data processing activities

To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information below.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our services are not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you discover that we have inadvertently collected children's information, please contact us immediately and we will promptly delete it.

changes.title: 9. Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Significant changes will be notified through website notices or email. We recommend regularly reviewing this page for the latest privacy practices.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
contact.content:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or need to exercise your rights, please contact us:

Email: privacy@enjoysa.com.au
Address: Adelaide, South Australia, Australia
Phone: +61 8 XXXX XXXX

We will respond within 30 days of receiving your request.
